sourceTitle: Scituate: 6. MOTIONS AT THE ANNUAL FINANCIAL TOWN MEETING
exactQuestion: Shall an act, passed at the 2026 session of the General Assembly, entitled "An Act regarding motions at the Town of Scituate annual Financial Town Meeting" be approved?
officialStatement: This act requires prior notice and posting of motions to be made from the floor at the annual Financial Town Meeting of the Town of Scituate now held on the first Tuesday in the month of June. This requirement does not apply to special meetings held under R.I. Gen. Laws §45-3-6 or §45-3-7.
